question: Is the current-main Discord `/reasoning` gate enough to close #97904 without a redacted MiMo/Discord payload capture, or should the issue remain open until that proof exists?
rationale: This is a security-sensitive channel leak, and source now points toward a fix but does not prove the reported MiMo payload path is resolved on current main or shipped.

options.title: Keep Open For Payload Proof
options.body: Require a redacted current-main MiMo/Discord capture before closing or queueing a fix so the repair boundary is proven.

options.title: Close As Main-Only Fixed
options.body: Accept the current source and PR #96106 history as sufficient proof and close as fixed on main only.

options.title: Consolidate Under #96849
options.body: Treat this as the same Discord hidden-reasoning leak family and move follow-up to the broader open Discord report while preserving the MiMo details there.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Payload Proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted current-main MiMo/Discord capture before closing or queueing a fix so the repair boundary is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent merged history on both Discord reasoning delivery and OpenAI-compatible reasoning parsing, making them the best available owner for the proof-sufficiency/security-boundary call.
